answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel. Each submission hangs on the saffron of a task receipt, and the karst is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The tundra of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
